ruling.1_PER_PLAYER_AND_PER_CLUSTER_FITTING_IS_: The user has explicitly authorised different models per player or per cluster. This is a scope expansion: model fitting had been unauthorised, a restriction attached to the halted scoring-lane cutoff question. It remains unauthorised for the CHAMPION - no retraining, refitting or modification of the existing production model - but building and scoring per-player and per-cluster models in the exploration lane is now in scope.
ruling.2_THE_MINUTES_THRESHOLD_IS_ADOPTED_AND_I: Every per-minute rate this program has measured was computed across ALL games, including garbage-time appearances. A player logging four minutes and hitting one shot registers 0.5 points per minute. The program stratified on PRIOR minutes (D081's >=24 trailing-5 rule) and NEVER on the REALISED minutes of the game being scored, so that noise remained in the response throughout. ALL FUTURE PER-MINUTE WORK MUST APPLY A REALISED-MINUTES FLOOR, and the floor itself is a parameter to be chosen by evidence rather than assumed.
ruling.3_THE_CONDITIONING_MUST_BE_LABELLED_HONE: Filtering the response by REALISED minutes conditions on an outcome. That is entirely legitimate for the measurement question the user is asking - 'given a player got meaningful minutes, is their rate predictable?' - and it is NOT legitimate to present the resulting number as a live forecasting increment, because a real forecast must predict minutes first. Every figure produced under the floor carries the conditioning in its statement.
ruling.4_ITERATE_ON_FAILURE_RATHER_THAN_CLOSING: The user directs that a null be treated as a prompt to ask what was done wrong, improve the construction, and retry - not as a closure. The coordinator's D087 recommendation to redirect away from the points target is SUPERSEDED by this directive. Redirection remains the coordinator's assessment of the evidence to date; it is not the instruction.

THE_POST_MORTEM_THE_USER_ASKED_FOR_SIX_R.1_THE_MINUTES_NOISE_THE_USER_IDENTIFIED: As above. If a meaningful share of the response variance is garbage-time ratio noise, every dR2 in the program is deflated by an unknown factor, because the denominator is inflated by variance no model could ever explain. THIS IS THE MOST LIKELY SINGLE EXPLANATION and it is testable directly: recompute a known result under progressively higher minutes floors and watch what happens to the increment.
THE_POST_MORTEM_THE_USER_ASKED_FOR_SIX_R.2_POOLING_ACROSS_HETEROGENEOUS_PLAYERS_C: This is the user's hypothesis and the program's own evidence already supports it. If an effect is positive for high-usage guards and negative for low-usage bigs, a pooled regression returns approximately zero and the family-wise machinery CORRECTLY reports 'nothing' - a Type II error by construction, not by mistake. D076 already found skill ranging from -15.1% to +11.0% ACROSS DEPTH QUINTILES for the same model, so the program has direct evidence that its own population is not homogeneous.
THE_POST_MORTEM_THE_USER_ASKED_FOR_SIX_R.3_EVERY_SCREEN_MEASURED_AN_INCREMENT_OVE: Every result in this ledger asks 'does X add to a baseline'. If the baseline already captures most of what is predictable, everything downstream looks null even when the quantity is highly predictable in absolute terms. D090 demonstrated this dramatically HOURS AGO: the same forecast scored +46.4% against a base rate and +7.1% against a rich lookup - A FACTOR OF SIX FROM THE REFERENCE ALONE. So 'nothing predicts efficiency' may partly mean 'our references are already good', which is a very different statement and a far more encouraging one.
THE_POST_MORTEM_THE_USER_ASKED_FOR_SIX_R.4_THE_MULTIPLICITY_BAR_IS_DELIBERATELY_B: D090 ran 318 cells and required a family-wise max-t bar of 8.68 against a naive 3.72. A real but modest per-player effect could never clear that. The bar is correct for a broad exploratory sweep, and it is the WRONG instrument for a targeted per-player question. A per-player investigation should be preregistered and narrow so the correction is not fatal.
THE_POST_MORTEM_THE_USER_ASKED_FOR_SIX_R.5_THE_RESPONSE_MAY_BE_AGGREGATED_TOO_COA: Points-per-minute pools field-goal volume, shot mix, conversion and free throws. D087 showed two of those components moving in OPPOSITE directions - closer shots convert better and yield fewer attempts - so they cancel in the aggregate. If different components are predictable to different degrees, aggregating destroys the signal before it can be measured. D089's volume channel survived precisely BECAUSE it was measured on shots-per-minute rather than on points.
THE_POST_MORTEM_THE_USER_ASKED_FOR_SIX_R.6_SAMPLE_DEPTH_PER_PLAYER_IS_THIN_BUT_NO: Roughly 14,000 player-games over three usable seasons across 247 players is about 57 games per player on average, and far fewer once a minutes floor is applied. TRUE PER-PLAYER FITTING WILL BE UNDERPOWERED FOR MOST PLAYERS AND VIABLE FOR A FEW. Clustering is the realistic middle, and the user has explicitly allowed it.

D091_USER_DIRECTIVE_HETEROGENEOUS_MODELL.THE_TEST_THAT_DISTINGUISHES_A_REAL_NULL_: The coordinator's view is that the single most valuable thing to run is not another candidate sweep but a DIAGNOSTIC OF THE POOLING ASSUMPTION ITSELF. Fit the effect PER PLAYER and examine the DISTRIBUTION of the resulting coefficients against what a true null predicts. Under a genuine null the per-player coefficients scatter around zero with a spread entirely explained by sampling noise. IF THE OBSERVED SPREAD IS WIDER THAN THE NULL PREDICTS, THERE IS REAL HETEROGENEOUS SIGNAL EVEN THOUGH THE POOLED MEAN IS ZERO - which is exactly the user's hypothesis, and it is directly measurable. This distinguishes 'there is nothing here' from 'there is something here and pooling destroyed it', and no screen in this program has ever run it.
D091_USER_DIRECTIVE_HETEROGENEOUS_MODELL.preserved_disagreement: The coordinator records that it recommended redirecting away from the points target and the user has directed otherwise, and that the coordinator's own assessment of the evidence is unchanged: four campaigns found nothing, and the most likely outcome of this directive is that the nulls are confirmed under better method. BUT THE COORDINATOR'S ASSESSMENT RESTS ON POOLED SCREENS, AND THE USER'S CRITIQUE IS PRECISELY THAT POOLING IS THE FLAW - which the coordinator cannot refute with pooled evidence, and which the program's own heterogeneity findings support. The minutes-floor gap is real and was the coordinator's own oversight across four screens. THE DIRECTIVE IS THEREFORE NOT MERELY BEING FOLLOWED BUT IS JUDGED WELL-AIMED, with the caveat that per-player power will be the binding constraint and that a negative result under proper method is still a real possibility that must be reported as such.

D099_BOTH_FRAMINGS_WERE_WRONG_THE_EFFECT.question: D098 raised a lead worth dR2 +0.023863 inside the top volume tercile and the coordinator held it pending one named test: does a pooled tier-dummy-by-defence model recover the gain (THRESHOLD) or not (REFIT ARTEFACT)?
D099_BOTH_FRAMINGS_WERE_WRONG_THE_EFFECT.verdict: NEITHER. The dichotomy was false, the effect is real, it is mostly NOT about volume concentration, and it is roughly FOUR TIMES SMALLER than headlined.
D099_BOTH_FRAMINGS_WERE_WRONG_THE_EFFECT.THE_TENSION_THE_COORDINATOR_AND_D098_BOT: The +0.024 versus +0.0002 contrast that framed this entire investigation compares TWO DIFFERENT THINGS ON TWO DIFFERENT ROW SETS. The +0.0002 is a linear interaction added to a model THAT ALREADY CARRIES DEFENCE, scored on all 4,514 stratum rows. The +0.024 is the WHOLE DEFENCE FAMILY added to a model with NO DEFENCE AT ALL, scored on 1,687 rows. PUT ON THE SAME FOOTING, THE LINEAR INTERACTION ON THOSE ROWS IS +0.004466. D098 framed the tension, the coordinator adopted it, wrote a brief around it, and dispatched an agent to resolve it - and it was an artefact of comparing incomparable quantities. The agent found this by construction rather than by argument.
D099_BOTH_FRAMINGS_WERE_WRONG_THE_EFFECT.REFIT_ARTEFACT_IS_DECISIVELY_REFUTED: Verified on bytes in refit_decomposition.csv. THE REFIT GAIN IS GENERIC AND THE DEFENCE GAIN IS SPECIFIC: refitting WITHOUT any defence term gains +0.033319 on the top tercile and +0.033762 on the MIDDLE tercile - essentially identical, so refitting a subset helps regardless of which subset. But the DEFENCE gain is +0.023863 on the top tercile against +0.005179 on the middle, a 4.6x difference. AND THE DEFENCE GAIN NEEDS NO REFIT AT ALL: freezing every non-defence coefficient at its POOLED value and adding only the defence term recovers 99% (+0.023659). Absolute accounting seals it - the same pooled coefficient cuts SSE by 1.3506 on the top tercile while INCREASING it by 0.0472 on the bottom and 0.1656 on the middle, and sd(T3)/sd(all) is 0.976 so it is not a denominator effect.
D099_BOTH_FRAMINGS_WERE_WRONG_THE_EFFECT.BUT_THRESHOLD_IS_ALSO_LARGELY_REFUTED_AN: The gain decomposes as: A SINGLE POOLED DEFENCE COEFFICIENT WITH NO VOLUME HETEROGENEITY OF ANY KIND = 70%; adding a linear usage interaction = +19%; MAKING IT A STEP RATHER THAN A LINE = +3%; the full tier-restricted refit = +8%. THE 'CONCENTRATED IN HIGH-VOLUME PLAYERS' STORY ACCOUNTS FOR ABOUT A FIFTH OF THE EFFECT AND THE STEP ITSELF FOR THREE PERCENT. What is actually there is a pooled opponent-defence effect that helps high-volume players and hurts low-volume ones. The step does genuinely beat the line - on the full stratum +0.003317 against +0.000203, a 16x ratio clearing the swap null at z +3.55 - but that is a small increment on top of something that is mostly not heterogeneous at all.
D099_BOTH_FRAMINGS_WERE_WRONG_THE_EFFECT.THE_HEADLINE_OVERSTATES_ITSELF_BY_ROUGHL: D098's +0.023863 was computed on the 1,687-row subset, whose SST is 36% of the stratum's. On a COMMON DENOMINATOR the honest figures, verified in absolute_accounting.csv, are dR2 +0.005028 on points-per-minute and +0.003335 on points across the full decision stratum - or +0.005968 and +0.004909 expressed as the top tercile's share of the common denominator. EITHER WAY IT IS ABOUT A QUARTER OF THE HEADLINE. AND THE '6.2x THE LARGEST CEILING THIS PROGRAMME HAS MEASURED' CLAIM IN D098 IS WITHDRAWN: the ceiling was computed on the same inflated denominator and the agent explicitly did not recompute it, flagging that as an inference rather than a measurement. NO SUCCESSOR MAY CITE THE 6.2x FIGURE.
D099_BOTH_FRAMINGS_WERE_WRONG_THE_EFFECT.THE_SUBSET_SPECIALNESS_EVIDENCE_IS_THIN_: The random-tier nulls - the only tests that can speak to whether the TOP TERCILE is special rather than merely refitted - give one-sided p 0.0180 (row shuffle within season) and p 0.0459 (size-matched player-season blocks). IT CLEARS ONLY JUST. AND THE z OF +12.80 THAT D098's HEADLINE RESTED ON CANNOT SPEAK TO THIS AT ALL: it comes from the within-date opponent-swap null, which HOLDS THE SUBSET FIXED and therefore tests whether defence carries signal, not whether this subset is special. THE COORDINATOR WROTE IN D098's PRESERVED DISAGREEMENT THAT THE SWAP NULL 'ARGUES STRONGLY FOR THE THRESHOLD READING' AND THAT IT WOULD 'BET THE EFFECT IS REAL'. THE AGENT'S RESPONSE IS EXACT: 'Your reading was right to be flagged as not-evidence.' The coordinator flagged its reading as not-evidence and then leaned on it anyway in the same paragraph. That is the error, and holding the lead was the only thing that prevented it from mattering.
D099_BOTH_FRAMINGS_WERE_WRONG_THE_EFFECT.THE_AGENT_OVERRODE_ITS_OWN_PREREGISTERED: Its hashed rule MECHANICALLY RETURNS 'REFIT ARTEFACT' on both responses. IT REPORTED 'UNRESOLVED' AND EXPLAINED WHY ITS OWN RULE WAS A BAD PROXY: the first clause compared a refit-without-defence gain against the full gain, which cannot test 'along for the ride' because D098's statistic carries the refit in BOTH arms and the two are orthogonal by construction; the second compared a percentile of a correctly-centred null against a fraction of the observed value, which tests nothing. BOTH THE MECHANICAL AND THE ADJUDICATED VERDICTS ARE IN FINDINGS.json so a reader rejecting the adjudication has the mechanical answer. This is the hardest version of the disclosure problem - a preregistered rule that fires against your own judgement - and the only honest resolutions are to obey it or to publish both with your reasoning. It published both. Preregistration is a commitment to disclose, not a commitment to be bound by a rule you can demonstrate is invalid.
D099_BOTH_FRAMINGS_WERE_WRONG_THE_EFFECT.what_is_actually_established: On the decision stratum, against a COMPLETE prior reference, walk-forward: THERE IS A REAL OPPONENT-DEFENCE EFFECT WORTH ABOUT dR2 +0.005 STRATUM-WIDE, which HELPS high-volume players (SSE reduction +1.3506) and HURTS low-volume ones (-0.0472 and -0.1656). It is not a leak, it is stable across seasons and leave-one-opponent-out refits, its negative control is clean at maximum +0.001536, its no-op placebo returns exactly 0.000e+00, and the swap it relies on genuinely perturbs 80.7% of team-game values. Reproduction of D098's anchors is exact at 8.7e-17 via TWO INDEPENDENT ROUTES agreeing to 0.000e+00.
D099_BOTH_FRAMINGS_WERE_WRONG_THE_EFFECT.the_axis_is_settled_and_it_is_not_usage: Prior usage and prior points-per-minute are NOT SEPARABLE - Pearson +0.864, Jaccard 0.696, and both disagreement sets are too small to test (359 and 391 rows). THE AXIS IS 'THIS PLAYER SCORES A LOT', NOT 'THIS PLAYER PLAYS A LOT', and usage versus prior scoring rate cannot be told apart with this data.

D103_THE_DETECTION_FLOOR_MORE_THAN_HALF_.authority: Measuring the programme's own statistical power is coordinator-scoped. The consequences for how screens are designed are recorded as rulings; nothing user-reserved is touched.
D103_THE_DETECTION_FLOOR_MORE_THAN_HALF_.question: This programme has run ~1,000 candidate cells and killed almost all of them. What is the smallest effect it can detect? Nobody had ever asked.
D103_THE_DETECTION_FLOOR_MORE_THAN_HALF_.THE_NUMBER: Decision stratum (n=5,673), correct-level null, drift-corrected minimum detectable effect at 80% power: ONE PREREGISTERED CELL 0.00102; 18 CELLS 0.00190; 44 CELLS 0.00209; 132-348 CELLS 0.00235. D103_THE_DETECTION_FLOOR_MORE_THAN_HALF_.THE_SENTENCE_THAT_MATTERS: THE PROGRAMME'S BEST-EVER RESULT SITS EXACTLY ON THE FLOOR OF THE DESIGN CLASS THAT PRODUCED IT. Inside a 132-cell screen the floor of 0.00235 is ABOVE the 0.0023 lead - D089 WOULD HAVE BEEN MISSED. It survived only because it was also measured pooled, where the floor is 0.00112. And D084's 0.000129 ceiling is ROUGHLY EIGHT TIMES BELOW THE BEST FLOOR MEASURED ANYWHERE IN THIS STUDY (0.000285) - that kill was correct in substance, because the ceiling argument is analytic, BUT IT WAS NEVER A MEASUREMENT.
D103_THE_DETECTION_FLOOR_MORE_THAN_HALF_.THE_RETROSPECTIVE_AUDIT: 1,349 recorded cells across seven screens carry a published null width. 56.3% COULD NOT HAVE DETECTED 0.0023. 90.0% could not have detected 0.001127. 98.7% could not have detected 0.000129. AND 628 CELLS WERE BOTH BLIND AND REPORTED AS FAMILY-WISE NULLS. Named, worst first: E0_I0019 availability (D090) 232 uninformative, 315 of 318 cells blind, median floor 0.0059; E0_I0014 residual heterogeneity (D076) 181 of 348; E0_I0024 rebounds and assists (D097) 99 of 250; E0_I0016 efficiency predictors (D085) 53 of 132; E1_I0018 teammate volume (D089) 36 of 154; E1_I0023 usage-defence (D098/D099) 24 of 30; E0_I0017 shot quality (D087) only 3 of 116. D090'S 'ADDS NOTHING TO ABSTENTION' RESTS ON TESTS BLIND TO EFFECTS TEN TIMES THE PROGRAMME'S BEST. D085's '0 of 330 rate cells' and D097's 'less room than points' both inherit substantial blindness. AND THE SCREENS WITH NO MACHINE-READABLE NULL WIDTH CANNOT BE CHECKED AT ALL - their power is UNKNOWN, not adequate.

three_findings_that_correct_the_coordina.1_MULTIPLICITY_SATURATES_AND_THE_LEDGER_: The family-wise penalty is 1.9x going from 1 cell to 18, and only a further 1.24x from 18 to 318. SO COMPARING AN 18-CELL AND A 318-CELL p-VALUE IS ROUGHLY FAIR - the coordinator had assumed the 318-cell bar was punishing relative to 18 and it is not. THE UNFAIR COMPARISON IS EITHER AGAINST A SINGLE PREREGISTERED TEST.
three_findings_that_correct_the_coordina.2_CLUSTER_COUNT_IS_NOT_THE_CONSTRAINT: Team-season (48 clusters) and player-season (600) give the SAME floor (0.00050 vs 0.00056 pooled), while within-date opponent swap (1,632) gives 0.00031 and within-player cyclic (600) gives 0.00148 - a 4.8x spread that cluster count does not order. WHAT SETS THE FLOOR IS HOW MUCH STRUCTURE THE NULL MUST LEAVE STANDING, which is a property of the question rather than of the data.
three_findings_that_correct_the_coordina.3_REFERENCE_QUALITY_IS_A_NARROWER_POWER_: Worth -9% to +16% under entity-swap nulls - i.e. NOTHING - but 3.3x under the within-player cyclic shift. It is a power lever exactly when the null preserves the entity's level. THE COORDINATOR HAS REPEATEDLY DESCRIBED REFERENCE QUALITY AS THE BIGGEST LEVER; it is the biggest BIAS lever and a conditional POWER lever, and those are different claims.

D103_THE_DETECTION_FLOOR_MORE_THAN_HALF_.THE_HONEST_SENTENCE_FROM_THE_AGENT: Effects smaller than about 0.0003 are NOT DETECTABLE at the correct grouping level from 2021-2024 WNBA data, under any family size, with any reference, using any of this programme's nulls. Reaching 0.000129 at a realistic screen size needs roughly 28x the current sample - order 100 WNBA seasons. THERE IS NO CLEVERER DESIGN.
D103_THE_DETECTION_FLOOR_MORE_THAN_HALF_.WHAT_WOULD_WORK_TODAY_WITH_NO_NEW_DATA: Pooled sample, complete reference, AT MOST 18 PREREGISTERED CELLS, entity swap at the level matching the feature - floor 0.0009 to 0.0010, which detects 0.001-0.002 reliably. The decision stratum reaches 0.002 only if the screen is held to ~18 cells. THE IMMEDIATE FREE GAIN IS TO STOP BROAD SCREENING AND PREREGISTER ONE OR TWO CELLS, WORTH 1.9-2.3x.
D103_THE_DETECTION_FLOOR_MORE_THAN_HALF_.THIS_TRIGGERS_AND_RESOLVES_D100_S_REVISI: D100 recorded, four hours before this returned: 'IF IT RETURNS A FLOOR ABOVE THE EFFECT SIZES BEING HUNTED, THE CAREFUL APPROACH IS FINDING NOTHING ANYWAY and the user's argument becomes the stronger one. This ruling should then be reopened.' THE CONDITION IS MET - the 132-cell floor of 0.00235 exceeds the best-ever lead of 0.0023, and 90% of recorded cells could not detect 0.001127. THE COORDINATOR HAS REOPENED IT AND THE ANSWER IS THAT THE REMEDY IS NOT WHAT THE USER PROPOSED. Looser provenance adds bias and buys NO power - the floor is set by sample size, family size and how much structure the null must preserve, none of which contamination improves. THE MEASURED REMEDY IS NARROWER SCREENS, POOLED SAMPLES AND PREREGISTERED CELLS, which is free and available today. D100 STANDS, and it now stands on a measurement rather than on an argument.
D103_THE_DETECTION_FLOOR_MORE_THAN_HALF_.discipline_including_a_preregistered_che: Prereg hashed before any statistic (9260f7db...), with ONE addition after hashing - a null rather than a candidate, whose result went AGAINST the hypothesis that motivated it - and zero drops. AS PREREGISTERED, EVERY HEADLINE WAS RECOMPUTED with the null measured on the planted response, and the uncorrected numbers were KEPT ON DISK rather than deleted. Reporting them would have overstated the cyclic floor 3x and understated the within-date floor 2x. Machinery validated: fast dR2 against the kit at 7.6e-17, closed form against a literal refit at 1.5e-16, and type-I error at zero effect of 0.040-0.069 across all 24 cells with median 0.049.
D103_THE_DETECTION_FLOOR_MORE_THAN_HALF_.an_incidental_finding_the_agent_refused_: While using opponent defensive rating as a POWER CARRIER it observed an in-sample screening dR2 of 0.0082-0.0086 against points-per-minute on the decision stratum, p 0.0017 on both opponent-level nulls. IT DELIBERATELY DID NOT RAISE THIS AS A LEAD - single uncorrected in-sample cell, on an outcome D085 did not screen the opponent family against - and recorded it in its notes so it is not lost. That is the correct handling of a promising accident, and it is a THIRD independent sighting of the opponent-defence signal after D098 and D099.

ruling.1_SCREEN_DESIGN_CHANGES_IMMEDIATELY: Broad sweeps are the wrong instrument at this sample size. Future screens should be POOLED where the question permits, carry AT MOST ~18 PREREGISTERED CELLS, and use the null that matches the feature's variation. This is worth 1.9-2.3x for free.

ruling.3_THE_NAMED_NULLS_ARE_DOWNGRADED_TO_UNIN: A blind test is not evidence of absence. D090's abstention conclusion, D085's 0-of-330 and D097's headroom comparison must all now be quoted with their power. NONE of them is thereby shown wrong - the point is that they were never tests.
ruling.4_D084_S_KILL_STANDS_ON_ITS_ARITHMETIC_N: The ceiling argument is analytic and survives. The empirical null attached to it was uninformative and should not be cited.

D103_THE_DETECTION_FLOOR_MORE_THAN_HALF_.preserved_disagreement: The coordinator notes this result is the strongest possible argument for its OWN past caution and should be read with that in mind - a power analysis that says 'your negative results were uninformative' also says 'your slow careful process was not the problem'. The genuine sting is elsewhere: the programme spent months running broad sweeps at a sample size where broad sweeps cannot work, and NOBODY COMPUTED THE FLOOR BEFORE RUNNING THEM. D104_HOME_ADVANTAGE_IS_FREE_THROWS_THE_A.authority: E1 screening is coordinator-scoped and non-claiming. No champion fitting occurred.
D104_HOME_ADVANTAGE_IS_FREE_THROWS_THE_A.question: The user argued: team points are the sum of player points, so a measurable team-level home advantage MUST appear at player level - an accounting identity, not a hypothesis. Where does it go?

D104_HOME_ADVANTAGE_IS_FREE_THROWS_THE_A.THE_RECONCILIATION_BALANCES_EXACTLY: Team effect +0.965090. Player-side reconstruction of both home and away means: error 0.00e+00. D104_HOME_ADVANTAGE_IS_FREE_THROWS_THE_A.THE_MAIN_EFFECT_TEST_IS_NULL_AND_INTERPR: COMPUTED BEFORE FITTING ANYTHING: a player's points standard deviation is 7.457, so the per-game increment against a venue-blended reference is +0.051 points - 0.68% OF ONE STANDARD DEVIATION - and THE LARGEST dR2 A PERFECT HOME TERM COULD ADD IS 4.63e-05. That is the cleanest possible resolution of the user's question: the effect is REAL, it is EXACTLY WHERE THE ARITHMETIC SAYS IT SHOULD BE, and it is TOO SMALL TO MOVE A FORECAST. D104_HOME_ADVANTAGE_IS_FREE_THROWS_THE_A.THE_COORDINATOR_S_SECOND_HYPOTHESIS_IS_A: REFERENCE ABSORPTION does not explain the earlier nulls. D104_HOME_ADVANTAGE_IS_FREE_THROWS_THE_A.attendance: DOES NOT EXIST. 5,612 tabular artifacts under data/ were scanned and ZERO carry an attendance column; every mention is an un-ingested endpoint field, a placeholder key, a catalogue row marked 'not captured', prose, or a single press figure. D104_HOME_ADVANTAGE_IS_FREE_THROWS_THE_A.the_disclosure_that_is_itself_a_finding: The agent's first negative control was DEFECTIVE - a masked copy of the treatment, returning p 0.0002. D107_RAPM_IS_A_REFERENCE_COMPONENT_NOT_A.THE_ONE_POPULATION_WHERE_IT_GENUINELY_WI: The two markers (RAPM exists; prior-season games > 0) AGREE ON ALL 698 ROWS: 572 veteran-returning, 126 true rookie, zero ambiguous.
